title: Flesh-eating screwworms spread to third state and are attacking pets
gist: The New World Screwworm infestation has spread to Arizona, joining New Mexico and Texas, with 74 US animal cases since the flies re-invaded in June, including 10 pet cases after four new dog cases and one cat this week. The flies returned after breaching the Darién Gap biological barrier in 2022, and Mexico has confirmed 806 human cases and nine deaths.
